comment: The drivers of every package of daasiot-android, one entry per <target>/<linkage> of android_daas/libdaas.lock.json. generic: the drivers of the libdaas package, "<id> <version>" as in its DRIVERS.txt; specialized: the drivers of this sdk built for the entry into the drivers_kit (android_daas/drivers_kit/<target>/static/), "<id> <version> <adapter>" with the version of <id>_version.hpp and the stack they run on (blew: the precompiled blew of the entry, on the Android BLE stack). blew: the precompiled packages of the DaaS Build Console (ext-dep, path under /scarica/), with their SHA-256. android-drivers-sdk/build_drivers_kit.py builds the kit of every entry and stops when a driver is missing, has another version or blew differs from the lock (--update-lock writes the SHA-256 of the blew it downloaded, after a review). Edit this file when a driver is added, removed or changes version, when blew changes and when an entry is added to the libdaas lock.
